Två belägg stöder förslaget.en: I defend the proposal with two evidence

texto: Integrate source reading, oral exposure, argumentation and self-assessment. **Två belägg stöder förslaget** means «I defend the proposal with two evidence». Analyzes the scope and registration of the expression. Distinguish the data of the interpretation, check what evidence it holds and practice a precise paraphrase. Sequence 2 of 3: incorporates this expression and reviews the above.
